label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. If a cookie banner offers no way to decline that works, accept it, report that as a problem, and carry on. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: Two dialogs opened at once on arrival (shipping country and cookie settings). The cookie dialog took focus, and the shipping dialog stayed open on top of the page until I confirmed it. The cookie banner offered only Preferences and Accept, so declining took an extra step through the preferences dialog, which has a very long intro text before the Reject All button.

After opening the category, the page first showed only FAQs with no product list, and the product list appeared only after I read the page a second time. I had no announcement that content was loading.

Every product card has a Quick add button with the same name, so I could not tell which product one belongs to. Product links have very long names that merge image description, badge, button text, name and price. Some links are repeated with only a headline and no price.

After opening the product page, the main area was empty at first and the content only showed after a second read. The page has two buttons both named Add to Cart, and the first one sits before the product heading, so it was unclear which one belongs to the product. After Add to Cart, the cart dialog first showed only its heading and the items appeared later with no announcement that the product was added.

The checkout page was blank at first (empty main area), then the form appeared only after a second read. The email newsletter checkbox is already ticked, so I would have to untick it to decline promotions. The address field is a combobox with no hint on how it behaves, and the page has an extra Complete your kitchen upgrade upsell with Add buttons placed before the order summary and the discount field.
